title: Insurance Verification
subtitle: Complete benefit breakdown
html:
STANDARD WEB VERIFICATION – $4.60

Online insurance verification with a structured clinical breakdown.

Includes:

  • ✓ Eligibility, deductible, and annual maximum
  • ✓ Amount already used from annual maximum
  • ✓ Whether deductible has been met or partially paid
  • ✓ Preventive, Basic, and Major coverage overview
  • ✓ Waiting periods (general and category-specific)
  • ✓ Missing tooth clause
  • ✓ Downgrades (composite resins, crowns, bridges)
  • ✓ Preventive treatment history
  • ✓ Age limitations (fluoride, sealants, space maintainers)
  • ✓ Orthodontic details: whether orthodontics is covered, maximum age limit for orthodontic coverage, and whether coverage applies to adults
  • ✓ SRP same-day quadrant allowance
  • ✓ Crown payment timing (prep date vs seat date)
  • ✓ General coverage overview (periodontics, endodontics, extractions, crowns, bridges, dentures)
  • ✓ Plan notes, limitations, and exclusions
  • ✓ Structured format for easy clinical interpretation

All information is entered into the clinical system for record accuracy and workflow use.

STANDARD PHONE VERIFICATION – $6.00

Manual verification performed directly with the insurance carrier.

Includes all services in Standard Web Verification, plus:

  • ✓ Exact procedure codes (when available)
  • ✓ Detailed frequency breakdowns (crowns, bridges, bone grafts, etc.)
  • ✓ Adjunctive General Services details
  • ✓ Expanded periodontal, endodontic, and oral surgery coverage
  • ✓ Detailed orthodontic verification (extended carrier confirmation)
  • ✓ Detailed plan limitations and exclusions
  • ✓ Coverage conditions affecting approval
  • ✓ Enhanced clinical and case acceptance notes

This service is used when online verification is not available or incomplete.

PEDIATRIC VERIFICATION (UNDER 14) – $3.70

Focused verification for pediatric patients.

Includes:

  • ✓ Fluoride coverage
  • ✓ Sealants
  • ✓ Space maintainers
  • ✓ Preventive pediatric benefits

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION – $0.15 PER ITEM

Applied per additional requested detail, including:

  • ✓ Extra procedure codes
  • ✓ Additional history or coverage notes
  • ✓ Expanded verification details
  • ✓ Supplemental insurance information

INSURANCE ACTIVE STATUS CHECK – $0.50

Quick verification to confirm current insurance status.

Includes:

  • ✓ Active or inactive status
  • ✓ Basic eligibility confirmation
  • ✓ Effective date validation

This is a limited check and does not include full verification details.

URGENT PROCESSING (ASAP) – +$1.00

Priority handling for same-day or expedited requests.

VOLUME PACKAGES (300+ VERIFICATIONS PER MONTH)

STANDARD VOLUME (300–599 MONTHLY)

Web: $4.40

Phone: $5.75

Pediatric: $3.50

HIGH VOLUME (600–1,199 MONTHLY)

Web: $4.20

Phone: $5.50

Pediatric: $3.30

ENTERPRISE VOLUME (1,200+ MONTHLY)

Web: $4.00

Phone: $5.25

Pediatric: $3.10

ORTHODONTIC VERIFICATION – $5.00

Dedicated orthodontic insurance verification with detailed benefit analysis for treatment planning and financial clarity.

Includes:

  • ✓ Orthodontic lifetime maximum coverage
  • ✓ Common orthodontic procedure codes (when available)
  • ✓ In-network vs out-of-network coverage percentage
  • ✓ Deductible applicability for orthodontic benefits
  • ✓ Age limitations for orthodontic coverage (adult vs dependent eligibility)
  • ✓ Payment structure details: paid at banding yes/no, whether payment at banding is automatic or requires submission, and payment frequency/schedule details
  • ✓ Fee schedule information
  • ✓ Coordination of benefits (if applicable)
  • ✓ Waiting periods specific to orthodontic coverage
  • ✓ Pre-authorization requirements
  • ✓ Medical necessity requirements (if applicable)
  • ✓ Additional plan limitations or restrictions

title: Payment Posting
subtitle: Flexible packages
html:
Our Service Packages

We offer flexible packages designed to meet the needs of dental practices of different sizes:

0–600 EOBs – $500

601–1,100 EOBs – $1,000

1,101–2,000 EOBs – $1,900

If your practice exceeds the number of EOBs included in your selected plan, any additional EOBs will be billed at a rate of $1.50 per EOB.

For larger clinics or high-volume practices, we also provide customized plans tailored to your specific needs. These plans can be discussed and adjusted to ensure the best fit for your workflow and volume.

Bonus: All plans include a monthly analytical report at no additional cost, providing clear insights into performance and billing activity.

title: Predetermination Support
subtitle: Organized case follow-up
html:
We provide the clinic with a structured Excel form that must be completed with basic patient and insurance information for each predetermination request. The process is simple, fast, and highly efficient to complete.

All submissions are reviewed twice per week, ensuring consistent processing and timely updates.

Each case is categorized into:

Accepted

Denied

Pending

This allows your team to easily organize patient follow-ups and schedule appointments accordingly.

Pricing (based on monthly volume)

Less than 20 patients – $85/month

20 to 50 patients – $120/month

50 to 80 patients – $160/month

80 to 150 patients – $200/month

150 to 250 patients – $280/month

250 to 400 patients – $350/month
